item.title: Trump asks SCOTUS to OK changes to mail-in ballots. And, diesel prices hit record high
item.description: Trump has asked the Supreme Court to lift the block on his plan for the USPS to restrict mail voting ahead of the midterm elections. And, diesel prices have reached a record high.

item.title: Who owns the beach? A heated battle plays out in the Florida Panhandle

item.title: Dry eyes are common in women. Here's why you shouldn't ignore them
item.description: Research suggests that around half of all women in the menopausal transition years experience symptoms, like red, watery or gritty-feeling eyes. Hormonal shifts play a role, as do many other factors.
